rootCauseAnalysis.primaryIssue: Port configuration mismatch between frontend and backend services
details: Frontend API client was configured for port 8085, but OpenAI API server was running on port 8086
Vite development proxy was routing to wrong port (8085 instead of 8086)
10-second timeout was too aggressive for complex goal processing operations (taking ~18s)
Both api.ts and vite.config.ts needed port corrections

implementedFix.description: Corrected port configuration and increased timeout for reliable API configuration and goal processing

changes: Updated Codespaces hostname replacement from port 8085 to 8086 (line 8)
Increased API timeout from 10000ms to 30000ms for complex processing (line 55)
Updated debug logging to reflect correct backend port 8086 (line 23)
Updated Vite proxy target from localhost:8085 to localhost:8086 (line 12)
Updated health endpoint proxy to correct port 8086 (line 28)
Updated both getApiBaseUrl functions to use port 8086 instead of 8085
Fixed Codespaces hostname replacement to use -8086 suffix

configurationUpdates: API client now correctly routes to OpenAI server on port 8086
Timeout increased from 10 seconds to 30 seconds for better reliability
Proxy configuration aligned with actual running services
ApiConfig component now connects to correct authentication endpoints
